svg.aria-label: Agent skills from th3-skills, along a track from idea to production. Plan: poc-spec-driven-builder (spec and tests first). Design: design-core (scored UI review), design-flow (Figma + flowchart). Build: prompt-cache-kit (cheaper agent runs), thai-mock-naming (safe mock data). Test: qa (evidence and reports), dependency-vuln-explainer (does a CVE reach you). Ship: devops (infra change, reported), doc-style-builder (Markdown to PDF + DOCX), pdf-operations (merge, split, stamp), podman-disk-reclaim (win back disk).
